## Quarto

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
mrp <- read_csv("../../data/clean/mrp-2013-2016-clean.csv")
pop_weight <- read_csv("../../data/clean/pop-weight-2013-2026-clean.csv")

set.seed(1)
mrp_sub <- mrp %>% slice_sample(n = 5000)

stopifnot(nrow(pop_weight) == 3 * 3 * 3 * 51)
P_arr <- aperm(array(pop_weight$N, dim = c(51, 3, 3, 3)), c(4, 3, 2, 1))
```

```{r}
stan_data <- list(
  N = length(mrp_sub$q2),
  income = mrp_sub$inc_idx,
  education = mrp_sub$edu_idx,
  age = mrp_sub$age_idx,
  state = mrp_sub$state_idx,
  y = mrp_sub$q2,
  P = P_arr
)

mod <- cmdstan_model(
  "models/mrp.stan",
  stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE)
)

fit <- mod$sample(
  data = stan_data,
  refresh = 100,
  show_messages = TRUE,
  show_exceptions = TRUE,
  parallel_chains = 4
)
```

```{r}
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
fit$save_output_files(dir = "fits", basename = "mrp_subset",
                      timestamp = FALSE, random = FALSE)
```

```{r}
fit$diagnostic_summary()
fit$summary(c("alpha", "sigma_beta_4", "phi"))
```

```{r}
state_labels <- sort(unique(pop_weight$`_STATE`))

phi_state_df <- fit$draws("phi_state", format = "draws_df") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(starts_with("phi_state")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(state_idx = as.integer(str_extract(param, "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(is.finite(value)) %>% # drops states with no poststrat cells
  group_by(state_idx) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(value),
    q05 = quantile(value, 0.05), q95 = quantile(value, 0.95),
    q25 = quantile(value, 0.25), q75 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(state = state_labels[state_idx],
         state = fct_reorder(state, median))

ggplot(phi_state_df, aes(x = median, y = state)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = q05, xmax = q95), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = q25, xmax = q75), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  labs(x = expression(phi[state]), y = NULL,
       title = "Posterior share optimistic by state",
       subtitle = "Median, 50% and 90% intervals") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
fit$summary("beta_4") %>%
  mutate(state_idx = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(count(mrp_sub, state_idx), by = "state_idx") %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, sd)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = state_idx)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_minimal()

state_names <- pop_weight %>%
  distinct(`_STATE`) %>%
  arrange(`_STATE`) %>%
  pull(`_STATE`)

mrp_sub %>% 
  count(state_idx) %>% 
  arrange(n) %>% head(10) %>% 
  mutate(state = state_names[state_idx]) %>% 
  relocate(state)
```

```{r}
state_names <- pop_weight %>%
  distinct(`_STATE`) %>%
  arrange(`_STATE`) %>%
  pull(`_STATE`)

fit$summary("phi_state") %>%
  mutate(state_idx = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "\\d+")),
         state = state_names[state_idx]) %>%
  arrange(desc(sd)) %>%
  select(state_idx, state, median, sd, q5, q95) %>%
  print(n = 12)
```
